title: Pause-screen hero art — cinematic close-ups (round 2)
subtitle: 1344x768 painted plates, no cutout. comfy.mjs `hero` preset, --ref at 0.5 against each subject's approved idle. NOTE ON THE CHAPTER ROW: a chapter plate is the PARTY MEMBER whose face carries that fight's emotional beat, framed in that fight's location — it is not a boss portrait. The boss is named because it names the chapter; where the antagonist is legible in the plate the caption says so.
